'''Stage I Rooters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns near a [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Stage II or III Beckon or Dispatcher]] with a 2% chance roughly every second.
** Can spawn naturally without the help of other Nexuses when [[Ubiquitous Development]] reaches level 3.
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage II Rooter]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
WIP 

*Grows into a [[Stage II Rooter]] after 12-14 minutes.
*Stage I Rooters throw 4 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. The bombs inflict 3 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage I Rooters can't break blocks.
*Stage I Rooters will permanently upgrade nearby parasites by increasing their generation to the max value regardless of stage.
*Stage I Rooters will hide their tentacles if the terrain around them is too small.
*Stage I Rooters can apply [[Pivot]] up to 20 blocks away.
*Stage I Rooters will apply the following effects to parasites:
**[[Pivot]] I (0:15)
**[[Parate]] I (0:15)
*Stage I Rooters can summon [[Rootmass Cyst]] when received damage.
*Stage I Rooters can spawn up to 3 [[Rootmass Cyst|Rootmass Cysts]], which have a 16 blocks range and a spawn cooldown of 12 seconds.
*The Rooter cap is 5 and the minimum distance between Rooters as to let one spawn is 32 blocks.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Stage I Rooters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Like all Nexuses, Stage I Rooters do not despawn by default.
* Stage I Rooters are known as '''Leem''' internally.
* Rooters have been confirmed to be based on lungs.
